design.processName: Job-work subcontracting for forged blanks: issue to heat treatment and shot blasting vendors, returns at Chakan or Bhosari, heat traceability, GST job-work reporting and vendor settlement

keyDesignDecisions.topic: Where stock at the job-worker is held: subcontracting stock at the vendor versus a subcontract PO with no stock visibility

options.name: Subcontracting stock held at the vendor in the LLP's own books
options.pros: Material stays in company stock until the vendor's receipt is closed, so stock at the six vendors is visible per part and heat and the INR 3.2 crore reconciliation gap closes.
options.cons: Requires the heat-numbered batch to survive the outward issue and every partial return; needs disciplined receipt posting by both Chakan and Bhosari.

options.name: Buy finished treated blanks back on a purchase order without vendor stock
options.pros: Simplest document flow; no stock-at-vendor to maintain.
options.cons: Loses the record of what is lying at the vendor, which is exactly the audit qualification; reconciliation would stay manual.

options.name: Custom-built vendor stock ledger outside the standard flow
options.cons: Duplicates stock, breaks the link to the challan and to the GST return, and adds custom code in the core with no upgrade safety.

keyDesignDecisions.recommendation: Subcontracting stock held at the vendor in the LLP's own books
keyDesignDecisions.rationale: The audit qualification and the stock-at-vendor requirement both depend on the material never leaving the LLP's stock while it is out, so the standard subcontracting flow is the cleanest fit; it also feeds the GST job-work return from the same records.

keyDesignDecisions.topic: How returns delivered straight to Bhosari are posted across the two legal entities

options.name: Post the receipt at Bhosari against the Chakan subcontract challan and clear it as an intercompany stock transfer
options.pros: The challan closes the day the return happens and Chakan's vendor stock is relieved immediately.
options.cons: Two company codes are touched by one physical movement, so the intercompany billing and the GST job-work reporting need a settled rule.

options.name: Post the receipt at Chakan first, then transfer the stock to Bhosari
options.pros: Keeps one company's books clean and simple.
options.cons: Adds a second posting per return and a delay, so the vendor stock ages wrongly until the transfer is posted.

options.name: Leave Bhosari receipts outside SAP and adjust Chakan monthly
options.cons: Repeats today's problem of Chakan never closing the challan and leaves the audit trail incomplete.

keyDesignDecisions.recommendation: Post the receipt at Bhosari against the Chakan subcontract challan and clear it as an intercompany stock transfer
keyDesignDecisions.rationale: Today nobody informs Chakan when parts go straight to Bhosari; posting at the receiving plant against the original challan is the only option that both closes the challan and shows the movement in the books of both companies. How the two companies bill each other and how the return is reported in the GST job-work return stays pending JWK-OQ-2.

fitGap.justification: SAP subcontracting keeps the issued components in a separate stock view at the vendor, so material out with each of the six vendors can be reconciled from system records instead of an audit finding; no build is implied because the outline step posts issue and return through standard subcontract order handling. Confirm the stock view per vendor before relying on it.
fitGap.validationReason: No verified catalog was supplied; confirm standard subcontracting stock-at-vendor handling in S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition 2702.

fitGap.justification: The system challan produced by the subcontracting issue (a goods-movement document carrying the job-work details) replaces the handwritten triplicate, and the records behind it feed the GST job-work return, so the Excel register can retire. Not CONFIGURATION because no customising is needed for the challan itself.
fitGap.validationReason: No verified catalog; confirm the India GST job-work challan and the job-work return are delivered with the public cloud localisation.

endToEndTests.valueStream: Blank issued to a heat treatment job-worker and returned to Chakan (challan to vendor reconciliation)
endToEndTests.given: Plant Chakan has 20 tonnes of forged crankshaft blanks in heat-numbered batches, and job-worker A is due to heat treat 8 tonnes on the released send list.
endToEndTests.when: The store keeper posts the system challan for the truck, the gate weighs it, the vendor returns the first partial lot and later the rest, and the monthly per-kilogram invoice is matched.
endToEndTests.then: Every kilogram is traceable to a challan and heat; the challan closes only when the returns are posted; the vendor's invoice is approved only on agreeing weight and pieces; and the stock-at-vendor balance for that vendor returns to zero.

endToEndTests.valueStream: Blank issued from Chakan and delivered straight to Bhosari machining (cross-company return)
endToEndTests.given: 6 tonnes of forged gear blanks are issued on a Chakan challan and the vendor, for its own reason, delivers the treated lot to Bhosari instead of back to Chakan.
endToEndTests.when: Bhosari posts the receipt against the Chakan challan with the heat numbers, the two company codes are cleared, and Chakan reviews the stock-at-vendor position.
endToEndTests.then: Chakan shows the material as returned the same day, the intercompany position is posted, the challan is closed, and the same lot appears in the Bhosari machining stock with its heat intact.

steps.title: Set up the two company codes, job-work stock view and heat batches
steps.trigger: The job-work subcontracting scope is approved for go-live and the company codes, plants and job-workers for heat treatment and shot blasting are known, so the organisational and master-data structure must be created before any challan can be issued.
inputDocuments: Approved organisation structure: company code 1000 for Shaktiman Forge LLP, company code 2000 for Shaktiman Auto Components Pvt Ltd, plant 1100 Chakan and plant 2100 Bhosari
List of the 6 outside job-workers for heat treatment and shot blasting with GSTIN and MSME status
Forged blank material list (crankshaft and gear blanks) with unit of measure and the alternative unit of measure used for job-work weight
Heat number convention used at Chakan forging and the vendor's declared heat number on return
Storage location list to be confirmed by the process owner (raw material, work in progress, finished goods, quality hold, scrap)
outputDocuments: Configured company code 1000 with plant 1100 Chakan and company code 2000 with plant 2100 Bhosari
Job-work stock view per job-worker (subcontractor) for the blank materials
Batch-managed blank materials with the heat number as batch number
Supplier master records for the 6 job-workers with job-work and MSME data
Information record per job-worker and blank material holding the per-kilogram processing charge and the blank input quantity

actions.operation: Confirm the organisational structure: company code 1000 carrying plant 1100 Chakan (Shaktiman Forge LLP) and company code 2000 carrying plant 2100 Bhosari (Shaktiman Auto Components Pvt Ltd); both are created as separate legal entities for statutory reporting.

Staff begins configuration of the purchasing and inventory organisation for job-work: the purchasing organisation that contracts the job-workers, the storage locations of plant 1100 and 2100, and the goods movement settings used by the issue and receipt steps. G/L accounts, tax codes and the GST-relevant settings are configured by the finance workstream.
Create the blank materials as batch-managed materials in plant 1100 with the kilogram factor for the per-kilogram processing charge; batching is mandatory so that a heat number can be carried.

Set the job-work stock view per job-worker: the subcontractor record is created so that issued blanks remain shown as company stock at the vendor's premises, not as a goods issue to consumption. This view is the structural precondition for the issue, the return and the stock-at-vendor reporting in the steps that follow.
Create the supplier master for each of the 6 job-workers: GSTIN, MSME registration and the MSME due-date determination that the payment step depends on, plus the purchasing and reconciliation data.
fields: bank details (maintained by the payment owning party, to be confirmed)

actions.operation: Create an information record per job-worker and blank material holding the per-kilogram processing charge basis and the blank quantity per finished piece, so that the issue, the receipt and the monthly invoice match can be addressed to the same contract.

Confirm the batch (heat) numbering rule and that the quality inspection at receipt can be set up by the inspection owner on the receipts that follow; the batch number carries the heat number exactly as declared by the vendor.

actions.actor: Plant Head Chakan, Mr. Rajesh Kulkarni
actions.operation: Sign off the set-up test: a trial job-work issue to one vendor must show the quantity still as company stock at that vendor and a trial return must be postable against the same trial challan. Set-up is released only after this test.

exceptions.condition: A job-worker is entered with a GSTIN that does not match the GSTIN on the vendor's job-work invoice
exceptions.response: Block that supplier for job-work transactions; the finance master data owner corrects the GSTIN against the vendor's registration certificate before the supplier is released again.

exceptions.condition: A blank material is created without batch management
exceptions.response: Reject the material at release; the materials master data steward sets batch management and re-runs the set-up test, because heat traceability cannot be carried without a batch.

exceptions.condition: A request arises to permit negative stock during set-up
exceptions.response: It is refused at set-up and recorded as held on JWK-OQ-1 until the Plant Head Chakan, Mr. Rajesh Kulkarni and the MD decide scope and treatment.
exceptions.owner: Plant Head Chakan, Mr. Rajesh Kulkarni

fields: company code 2000 (Shaktiman Auto Components Pvt Ltd)

masterData.object: Blank material master (crankshaft and gear blanks)

effects.inventory: No stock moves in this step. The structure is created so that a later issue shows blanks as company stock held at the vendor and a later return brings them back at Chakan or Bhosari; the job-work stock view is the bucket that makes stock at each of the 6 job-workers visible.
effects.financial: No financial transaction and no valuation change. The cost of the processing charge is agreed on the information record but nothing is accrued, billed or paid; the two companies remain separate for statutory reporting.
effects.ownership: Ownership stays with Shaktiman Forge LLP for material issued from Chakan to job-workers; custody passes at issue, which a later step records. Material received at Bhosari sits in Shaktiman Auto Components Pvt Ltd, a different legal entity, so ownership there is pending JWK-OQ-2.
effects.accountingEntry: None: this step only creates organisational units, master data and the job-work stock view, so no accounting document is posted.

steps.addedValue: The two legal entities, the six vendors and the blank materials exist once, in one system, with the job-work stock view and heat-numbered batches already in place. This removes the condition that lets the Excel challan tracker and the Excel ITC-04 register stay in use: from the first issue, every blank has a company code, a plant, a vendor account and a heat number to be traced against, instead of being re-typed into a spreadsheet after the fact.

businessRules.condition: A company code or plant is created
businessRules.response: Company code 1000 carries plant 1100 Chakan (Shaktiman Forge LLP) and company code 2000 carries plant 2100 Bhosari (Shaktiman Auto Components Pvt Ltd); no posting is allowed across the two without an inter-company step, which the later return-variant step must design.

businessRules.condition: A blank material is created or changed
businessRules.response: Batch management is mandatory and the batch number is the heat number; a material without batch management is rejected at set-up because heat traceability is requested in every return, stock-at-vendor and traceability requirement.

The job-work stock view is created for that supplier in plant 1100 so that issued blanks remain recognisable as company stock at the vendor; a supplier without the job-work view cannot receive a job-work challan and is rejected by the issue step.

businessRules.condition: A supplier record is created or changed
businessRules.response: GSTIN and MSME status are mandatory; the MSME flag and due-date logic drive the 45-day payment rule used in the payment step, so an unset field blocks release of that supplier for job-work transactions.

businessRules.condition: The charge basis for a job-worker and blank material is captured
businessRules.response: The per-kilogram basis and the blank input quantity per piece are recorded on the information record; the rate itself comes from the vendor contract and is not set in this step.

businessRules.condition: An issue is to run with stock not yet posted (negative stock) as the MD requires
businessRules.response: Pending JWK-OQ-1 and q_obs_o_75dcff2e-f6e3-46b7-8234-8b41ed013446_1: this set-up step does not switch on negative stock for any plant, storage location or batch, because the scope (job-work only or all plants), the treatment of heat-numbered batches and the interaction with the parallel LLP bookkeeping are undecided. The setting is held until the Plant Head Chakan, Mr. Rajesh Kulkarni and the MD decide.

businessRules.condition: A storage location for quality hold or scrap is configured
businessRules.response: Pending q_obs_o_b6555739-b387-4e37-a2d5-dbb9bf351c62_0, which must confirm whether quality hold and scrap need separate storage locations in each plant; until answered, the set-up is described as proposed and not released.

businessRules.condition: The parallel LLP bookkeeping in Tally is considered for set-up
businessRules.response: Pending JWK-OQ-6: which transactions are still booked in Tally, which in SAP and when Tally is switched off is not defined, so this step creates no parallel reconciliation structure or interface and no reconciliation report until the CFO decides.

businessRules.condition: A heat number is split across furnaces or mixed with other heats at the vendor
businessRules.response: Pending JWK-OQ-5: the set-up allows one batch per heat exactly as declared by the vendor; whether the vendor must return heat by heat or whether stock at vendors is tracked at that granularity is undecided, so no additional heat-splitting structure is built in this step.

implementation.detail: No verified SAP catalog entry exists for SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition 2702, so this step is set for validation. A consultant must confirm which configuration apps and settings in the target release realise: company code 1000 and 2000 with plants 1100 and 2100, material masters with mandatory batch management and a kilogram alternative unit, supplier masters with GSTIN and MSME fields, the subcontractor job-work stock view per vendor, and the information record carrying the per-kilogram charge basis. Validation points: no reference supports any of these objects, so none is claimed; negative-stock settings stay off pending JWK-OQ-1; separate quality-hold and scrap storage locations and the Tally parallel scope are open.

steps.title: Receive customer schedules through the customer channels
steps.trigger: A customer schedule arrives: Tata, Mahindra and Hyundai send monthly delivery schedules (Tata SupplierNet, Mahindra portal, email for others) and the German Tier-1 sends quarterly purchase orders with weekly call-offs by email.
inputDocuments: Monthly delivery schedule from Tata, Mahindra and Hyundai (portals SupplierNet and Mahindra, email for others)
Quarterly purchase order from the German Tier-1 with weekly call-offs by email
Customer master record and material master record per part number
As-Is Excel master tracker (reference only; not to be kept in the target flow)
outputDocuments: Scheduling agreement per customer and part number with schedule lines (monthly schedule plus weekly call-off)
Inbound schedule receipt log recording source channel, receipt time, file or message, and processing status per schedule

actions.operation: Take delivery of each inbound schedule through the channel the customer uses (Tata SupplierNet, Mahindra portal, email) and attach the received file or message to the schedule receipt log with its source and arrival time.
Read each received schedule line and map customer, plant and part number to the existing sales scheduling agreement; hold any line whose customer or part cannot be mapped.
Check the mapping and quantity of every held line and release it, or reject it back to the customer contact with the reason; no line is re-keyed by hand into a second tracker.
Write the monthly schedule and the weekly call-off into the scheduling agreement as schedule lines and save the agreement; the agreement is the single record that the Bhosari planner works from.
Close the receipt entry with its final status (accepted, held, rejected, duplicate) and the resulting scheduling agreement line, so every received schedule is accounted for once.

exceptions.condition: A customer portal or email schedule is delivered in a file whose parts or quantities cannot be read
exceptions.response: The receipt entry is set to failed with the received file attached; the sales coordinator requests a readable schedule from the customer contact and no schedule lines are written from the unreadable file. Pending q_st_c170b433-e309-4d38-a740-a19c57fb801b_5 and q_st_c170b433-e309-4d38-a740-a19c57fb801b_6, which must confirm the record and the responsible person per channel, the owner of this exception is Provisional owner to be confirmed: Sales coordinator.

exceptions.condition: A schedule line fails at the mapping check for a customer or part number that does not exist
exceptions.response: The line stays held, the customer master or material master gap is raised to the owner of that record, and the customer is asked to confirm the part number; the line is released only after the master record exists.
exceptions.owner: Sales admin master data owner (provisional, to be confirmed)

masterData.object: Customer master record (sold-to and ship-to party, including the German Tier-1)
fields: portal or email channel used by the customer

masterData.object: Material master record per part number
Scheduling agreement master data (customer-specific agreement with validity and call-off pattern)

effects.inventory: None: receiving a customer schedule changes no stock; no goods movement and no reservation is created by this step.
effects.financial: None: a schedule does not create a receivable, revenue or any other financial posting; billing arises only from dispatch and invoicing in later steps.
effects.ownership: None: no material changes hands or changes owner when a schedule is received.
effects.accountingEntry: None: this step only records customer schedules on scheduling agreements and posts no accounting document.

steps.addedValue: The monthly schedule and the weekly call-off land once, in one agreement that the Bhosari planner can read directly, so the sales coordinator's duplicate keying into Tally and the Excel master tracker disappears and the planner no longer works from a file that is a step behind the customer. Every received schedule is accounted for on a receipt log with a status, so a schedule that failed to load is visible instead of being discovered when a delivery is late.

businessRules.condition: An inbound schedule line carries a customer, part number and plant that map to exactly one scheduling agreement
businessRules.response: The line is written as a schedule line on that agreement and the receipt entry is set to accepted; no manual re-keying takes place.

businessRules.condition: A received schedule line cannot be mapped to a customer, part number or plant
businessRules.response: The line is held on the receipt entry with a hold status, the sales coordinator is notified, and the customer contact is asked to correct it; the held line is never posted into a guessed agreement.

businessRules.condition: The same customer schedule is received again (same customer, same schedule reference and same schedule period)
businessRules.response: The repeat is recorded as a duplicate and does not create a second set of schedule lines; the existing agreement lines are left unchanged, and only a superseding schedule that the customer explicitly issues replaces them.

businessRules.condition: A new schedule supersedes an earlier call-off for the same period
businessRules.response: The scheduling agreement carries the latest call-off; earlier call-off values are kept in the agreement history and are not deleted, so the change can be shown to the planner and to the customer.

businessRules.condition: The German Tier-1 sends a quarterly purchase order with weekly call-offs by email
businessRules.response: Proposed: the purchase order is held as the reference document on the scheduling agreement and each weekly call-off is written as a schedule line against it; whether this customer is to be handled as a scheduling agreement at all is pending q_st_c170b433-e309-4d38-a740-a19c57fb801b_5, which must decide the customer channel and record per customer.

businessRules.condition: A schedule arrives or is released
businessRules.response: No availability, reservation, delivery or billing document is created by this step; the release of the schedule for delivery is a planning decision of the Bhosari weekly machining plan, which is not part of this step.

implementation.detail: No verified SAP reference was available for SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition 2702, so the realisation is unconfirmed. To be validated: sales scheduling agreements with schedule lines and schedule-line history, the apps for creating agreements and maintaining schedule lines, and inbound channel handling for the customer portals and email. A channel that is not covered by a standard interface is expected to need an extension or an intermediary channel in the customer portal; the mechanism and any entitlement to an integration service are validation points.

acceptanceTests.given: A scheduling agreement exists for Tata and part number X at the plant that supplies Bhosari, and Tata SupplierNet delivers a monthly schedule with 1,200 pieces for part X plus a weekly call-off of 300 pieces
acceptanceTests.when: The schedule is taken in and released by the sales coordinator
acceptanceTests.then: The agreement for part X carries the 1,200-piece monthly schedule line and the 300-piece call-off, the receipt entry status is accepted, and no manual entry exists in the Excel master tracker

acceptanceTests.given: Mahindra sends by email a schedule containing a part number that has no material master record
acceptanceTests.then: That line is held with a hold status and is not written to any agreement, the master data gap is raised to the owner of the material master, and the remaining lines of the same schedule are processed independently

acceptanceTests.given: The same Tata weekly call-off for the same period is received a second time
acceptanceTests.then: The repeat is recorded as duplicate, no new schedule lines are created, and the agreement still shows one call-off for that period

eliminatedAsIsSteps.reason: The Bisosari weekly machining plan is superseded by planning driven from the received schedules; it creates no document used by the job-work flow and is designed in the production planning workstream.

Machining at Bhosari lies outside the job-work boundary, which ends when treated blanks are received; only that receipt is designed here and the machining operation belongs to the manufacturing workstream.

coverage.rationale: Every blank leaves on a system challan and every return closes against it, so the stock-at-vendor view reconciles vendor by vendor instead of ending in a qualified audit.
The handwritten triplicate challan and the Excel ITC-04 log give way to one system challan per truck that also feeds the GST return.

openQuestions.question: The MD requires blanks to be issued to job-workers even when the forged stock is not yet posted. Which issue transactions may run into negative stock, whether negative quantities are permitted on heat-numbered batches, and how the parallel LLP bookkeeping is kept in step, still have to be settled.
openQuestions.owner: Plant Head Chakan, Mr. Rajesh Kulkarni, with the MD

openQuestions.question: When treated blanks are delivered straight to Bhosari, it is unsettled which company code posts the receipt, how the material leaves the LLP's stock at the vendor and is billed between the two companies, and how that return appears in the GST job-work return.
